help.body: A "bundle" is a collection of your own published courses sold at a single price. This price is usually lower than the total price of individual courses; the difference is shown to the buyer as "savings". The buyer purchases the bundle once and is immediately enrolled in all courses inside the bundle (if they already own some, they won't be charged again). A bundle can be freely edited as long as it is a "draft"; to publish, it must contain at least two courses, and after publication, the courses and price are locked.
